lines.text: What if you woke up as a background character in a crime game?
You blink into existence on a sidewalk, ten seconds before the player drives by.
You try to scream for help. Instead, you say: Nice weather today.
You only have three lines, and you'll say them forever.
Your legs walk on their own. To the corner, turn around, and walk back.
You've passed this same hot dog stand four hundred times.
Then the player shows up. Car horns, explosions, a stolen fire truck on the sidewalk.
Everyone runs in exactly the same direction, flailing their arms.
A car clips you, and you go flying like a rag doll.
Then you blink, and you're back on the same sidewalk, like nothing happened.
So you try to escape. You walk and walk, until the city stops loading behind you.
Past the edge of the map, there's nothing. Just grey fog, and a floating car with no driver.
You go back, and this time, when the player stops, you say something new.
Hey. Want a hot dog? And the whole game freezes.
The player stares at you, and you stare right back.
So, if you were an NPC, what would your one line be?
